read_constants.no_rerun_discipline: This read may not be rerun with a different control seed to move thresholds.

g1_imprint.apparatus_limit: COARSE NULL: 3-block period over the 12-block primary set admits exactly 3 integer phase alignments -> 15 pooled seed-phase values; thresholds are the conservative MAX, not a percentile. Recorded as an apparatus limit.

g1_overdispersion.scope_note: Necessary, not sufficient, for G1b. Does NOT substitute for the full 135-row CM-0 comparator dominance rule (separate predeclared relation, evaluated after CM-0 exists). No result may say 'above CM-0' from this floor threshold alone.

g2_anchor.gate_note: Full-surface prop_I is the gate anchor (contract decomposition read).
g2_anchor.sign_separation_note: Signs reported separately before any sign-symmetry summary; trend per tier/per sign/across seeds; never sign-pooled.

constants.constants_scope: Per-tick distributions pooled over responsive cells |c|>=0.20, both signs, all seeds, all 200 ticks.

g4_compression.rule: A CM-1 row passes G4 only on all three criteria; mean slope alone never sufficient.

g3_rho_match.unit: window-mean rho of eligible primary windows
g3_rho_match.excluded_pair_classes: Same-tier cross-c and cross-sign pairs (incl. +c vs -c and small-|c| neighbors): candidate matched-rho targets, not strata to discriminate.
g3_rho_match.repair_note: v2 corrected cap rule (L2-arbitrated defect repair); v1 JSON invalid, preserved as *_INVALID_v1.json.
g3_rho_match.note: Setting-level mean difference below Delta_rho_match is descriptive only; never replaces bin-level common support.

g3_bin_eligibility.no_single_seed_dominance: No single seed may contribute more than half of qualifying windows on either side.
g3_bin_eligibility.phase_rule: Comparison is phase-stratified, OR both sides' window-start phase histograms over the three schedule phases match within one window per phase; enough-windows-but-phase-confounded bins are reported as common-support-present-but-phase-confounded and excluded from ordering claims.
g3_bin_eligibility.derivation: 9 primary windows/seed x 5 seeds = 45 instances/setting; N_bin_min = one complete primary-window-family equivalent.

time_shuffle_persistence_invariance.note: Per-cell time shuffle preserves each cell's time mean; persistence grid preserved exactly; diagnostic-only, never the operative persistence residue gate.

onset_null.operative_floor_conditional: MAX-OBSERVED is the operative per-window onset floor (raw and residue, per axis) until the setting-level earned-window rule is verified for the 9-window primary family; the 97.5th-percentile values travel alongside for when that verification lands.

feasibility_audit.method: Self-consistent mean-field fixed point rho* = p_eff(rho*)/(1-s+p_eff(rho*)), q=rho*, damped iteration.
feasibility_audit.rule: not_feasible or indeterminate halts automatic seedability and routes to Mike; never worked around by relaxing G3 after output. feasible is necessary, not sufficient.
feasibility_audit.cm0_static_note: CM-0 static levels audited at u/2 provisional (solved-offset rule pending its own pre-seed calculation).
